//: Courier tracking: a scheduled Railway service, same repository and Dockerfile, that checks the couriers for every parcel whose next check is due (tracking/management/commands/sync_carrier_tracking.py).
The 17TRACK webhook delivers most updates the moment they happen; this run is the safety net for pushes that were missed.
To create it: Railway > New > GitHub Repo > this repository, then in the service's Settings set Root Directory to `backend` and Config-as-code path to `railway.tracking-cron.json`.
Variables it needs: DATABASE_URL, DJANGO_SECRET_KEY, SEVENTEEN_TRACK_API_KEY, and the EMAIL_* set (customers are e-mailed about deliveries and problems).

deploy.//schedule: Every two hours. Each shipment is only asked about once every TRACKING_POLL_HOURS (default 6), so most runs send few requests.
deploy.//restartPolicy: NEVER: a scheduled job is meant to exit; a failed run is retried by the next one.
